title: Nataka kujaribu Wakala wa Hermes, lakini sijui inafanya nini

text.I want to try Hermes Agent, but I do not: Nataka kujaribu Wakala wa Hermes, lakini sijui inafanya nini
text.I want to get Hermes Agent running somed: Ninataka kufanya Wakala wa Hermes aendeshe siku moja.
text.But I still do not really understand how: Lakini bado sielewi jinsi ya kuitumia.
text.The only thing I know is that people say: Kitu pekee ninachojua ni kwamba watu wanasema kumbukumbu yake ni ya kushangaza.
text.So, in the end, what can it actually do?: Kwa hivyo, mwisho, inaweza kufanya nini hasa?
text.I want to understand Cursor again after: Nataka kuelewa Mshale tena baada ya kuiacha kwa Claude Code
text.I turn off everything that is not now: Ninazima kila kitu ambacho sio sasa
